This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Yes, including the BOM by default in CSV exports is deliberate, as spreadsheet applications use it to correctly detect UTF-8 encoding when files are opened directly. Because of this intentional behavior to ensure compatibility, the BOM will remain enabled by default.
